patterns: APPSC asks this as a saint-to-region match (Vallabha-Gujarat, Tulsidas-UP, Chaitanya-Bengal, Tukaram-Maharashtra) and a single-fact item (Mirabai = Rajasthan royal family; Shivaji's guru = Ramdas).
Other PSCs favour chronological ordering (Namdev, Kabir, Nanak, Chaitanya, Mirabai) and 'which is not by Tulsidas' work traps (Sahitya Lahari / Sahitya Ratna).
Recurring facts: Varkari seat Pandharpur, Namdev as Varkari saint, Bijak = Kabir, Rag Govind = Mirabai, Ramananda born at Prayag, Nanak in Sikandar Lodi's reign.
The app leans on multi-statement and 'how many pairs' formats and adds birthplace and guru-disciple matches more than APPSC asks; its core facts line up with the PYQ keys.
